entities.name: Denawa
entities.description: Northern of the two main islands of Orvada.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: Nation Orvada rivals and later made peace with.

entities.name: Scarmithals
entities.description: Beasts whose hides let wearers pass among them unnoticed.

entities.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
entities.description: Led the Serran troops supplied by Orvada.

events.summary: Gerrard Capashen and friends encounter a pack of scarmithals on Denawa; the soldiers kill them and take their hides.
events.quote: he ran into a pack of scarmithals.

events.summary: After the second Phyrexian Invasion, Orvada's merchant lords make peace with Benalia and supply Lyra's Serran troops.
events.quote: the merchant lords of Orvada made peace with Benalia
